title: Graph-Informed Deep Factor Model for Statistical Arbitrage
abstract: arXiv:2611.34209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Statistical arbitrage exploits temporary mispricings between similar assets in the cross-section of daily equity returns. We propose a nonlinear single-factor model, called a Graph-Informed Deep Factor (GIDF) model, whose per-stock loadings have cross-sectional dependence conditional on a latent network. The network captures cross-sectional return dependencies that remain after removing the dominant eigenmodes of the return correlation matrix, thereby providing a complementary representation of inter-asset relationships beyond the leading sources of systematic variation. It is reconstructed from data using a novel method that we call the Factor-Adjusted Dynamic EWMA (FADE). A signed-edge graph attention mechanism then combines the reconstructed network with exogenous firm characteristics and macroeconomic variables. This graph-informed specification is designed to produce residuals that more effectively separate idiosyncratic mean-revert

translated_title: 面向统计套利的图信息深度因子模型
translated_abstract: 统计套利利用日度股票收益横截面中相似资产之间的暂时性错误定价来获利。我们提出了一种非线性单因子模型，称为图信息深度因子模型，其个股载荷在给定潜在网络的条件下具有横截面依赖性。该网络捕捉了在去除收益相关性矩阵的主特征模态后仍然存在的横截面收益依赖性，从而在系统性变化的主要来源之外，为资产间关系提供了一种互补的表示方式。该网络通过一种我们称为因子调整动态EWMA（FADE）的新颖方法从数据中重建。随后，一种带符号边的图注意力机制将重建的网络与外生的公司特征和宏观经济变量相结合。这种图信息的模型设定旨在产生能够更有效地分离特异性均值回归……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出图信息深度因子（GIDF）模型，通过创新的FADE方法从数据中重建潜在网络，并利用带符号边图注意力机制融合公司特征与宏观变量，为统计套利构建能够更好分离个股特异性均值回归信号的非线性单因子模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Graph-Informed Deep Factor (GIDF) model for statistical arbitrage, which reconstructs a latent network via a novel Factor-Adjusted Dynamic EWMA (FADE) method and combines it with firm characteristics and macro variables through a signed-edge graph attention mechanism to better isolate idiosyncratic mean-reverting residuals.
